entities.summary: Admiral Juan José Navarro y Búfalo, 1st Marquess of Victoria, OSJ was a Spanish military officer who served as the first captain general of the Navy from 1750 to 1772. A leading proponent of naval reform, he provided much of the practical curriculum for the Academia de Guardias Marinas, established in 1717 to provide professional training for Spanish Navy officers.

entities.summary: Admiral Juan José Navarro y Búfalo, 1st Marquess of Victoria, OSJ was a Spanish military officer who served as the first captain general of the Navy from 1750 to 1772. A leading proponent of naval reform, he provided much of the practical curriculum for the Academia de Guardias Marinas, established in 1717 to provide professional training for Spanish Navy officers.
